text: どうじょうを　ぬけだして　でも　しはんの　すごさを　ひろめるっす　ウスッ！

structure.jp: どうじょうを　ぬけだして　でも
structure.en: even if I have to sneak out of the dojo

structure.jp: しはんの　すごさを　ひろめるっす

patterns.name: 〜てでも
patterns.explanation: でも after a て-form means 'even if I have to go as far as doing that'. ぬけだして　でも = 'even if I have to sneak out'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for さ turns it into a thing word, like '-ness'. すごさ = 'greatness'.
